rice.soil: Clay loam, alluvial soil with pH 5.5 - 6.5
rice.seed_rate: 20 - 25 kg/acre for direct broadcasting; 8 - 10 kg/acre for SRI method
rice.water: 1200 - 1400 mm (Requires 5cm standing water during tillering & flowering)
rice.fertilizer: 100kg Neem Coated Urea + 50kg DAP + 40kg MOP per acre (Split into 3 doses)
rice.common_diseases: Paddy Leaf Blast, Sheath Blight, Yellow Stem Borer, Bacterial Leaf Streak

tomato.soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter (pH 6.0 - 7.0)
tomato.common_diseases: Early Blight, Late Blight, Tomato Leaf Curl Virus, Fruit Borer

cotton.soil: Deep black cotton soil or well-drained loams (pH 6.0 - 8.0)
cotton.common_diseases: Pink Bollworm, Fusarium Wilt, Alternaria Leaf Spot

banana.soil: Rich fertile alluvial or clay loam soil (pH 6.5 - 7.5)
banana.common_diseases: Sigatoka Leaf Spot, Panama Wilt (Fusarium), Stem Weevil

maize.soil: Well-drained fertile loamy soil rich in organic matter (pH 6.5 - 7.5)
maize.common_diseases: Fall Armyworm (FAW), Maydis Leaf Blight, Charcoal Rot
